settings.history_title: History of Gwadar Ambulance Service & Bin Ahsaan Welfare Trust
settings.history_text:
Bin Ahsaan Trust and Gwadar Ambulance Services commenced operations on 1st January, 2022 (Registration No: Bcra-114272). The purpose of this service is to provide facilities and emergency assistance to the needy who are in emergency conditions. We also transport deceased bodies from one place to another with two ambulances.

The mission of this trust is to provide help to the people of Gwadar, Kech, and other adjoining areas. We believe that 24/7 service helps the community cover casualties and medical emergencies promptly.
settings.vision_text: Provision of prompt and speedy ambulance service in emergency to all needy people at Gwadar.
settings.service_areas: Gwadar City, Gwadar Surrounding Area, District Kech & Adjoining Areas (Proposed Expansion to Jewni)
settings.contact_address: Gwadar Ambulance Service Station, Gwadar, Balochistan
settings.contact_notice: All emergency ambulance, mortuary, and ritual washing (Ghusl) services are provided for the welfare of the people of Gwadar, Kech, and adjoining areas under Bin Ahsaan Welfare Trust (Reg No: Bcra-114272).

missionPoints.point_text: To save a life, to protect all humanity.
To save a life by provision of emergency ambulance service round the clock.
To assist ill and needy people at the time of emergency, assisting them to reach the nearest health services.
To provide all sort of help to the poor and needy people of Gwadar.
To be a partner in building a healthy, safe and secure environment.

services.title: 24/7 Emergency Medical Cases Transport
services.description: Round-the-clock prompt and speedy emergency ambulance service assisting critically ill and needy patients to reach the nearest health services across Gwadar City, Gwadar surrounding areas, and District Kech.

services.title: Obstetric Deliveries Emergency Transport
services.description: Dedicated emergency transport for maternal and obstetric delivery cases, ensuring expectant mothers in Gwadar and adjoining areas reach medical facilities safely and without delay.

services.title: Road Traffic Accident (RTA) Rescue
services.description: Immediate on-scene emergency response and casualty evacuation for road traffic accidents across Gwadar, Makran Coastal Highway, and connecting district routes.

services.title: Deceased Body Transport Service
services.description: Dignified transportation of brought-dead cases and deceased bodies from one place to another using two dedicated ambulances serving Gwadar, Kech, and adjoining areas.

services.title: Mortuary Preservation Facility
services.description: Equipped mortuary preservation service maintaining health and preservation standards with dual-chamber stainless steel refrigerated units (41 male and 2 female deceased bodies preserved).

services.title: Ritual Washing & Shrouding of the Deceased (Ghusl)
services.description: Complete Islamic ritual washing (Ghusl) and shrouding of the deceased performed with dignity and care by dedicated Gosal staff.

services.title: Disaster & Flood Rescue Operations
services.description: Active field rescue operations during natural disasters in Gwadar, including the Ganz Koh-e-Daran mountain collapse (23/10/2022) and Gwadar Flood rescues on 26/02/2024 (28 households) and 11/03/2024 (16 households).

services.title: Free Medicine Camps & Community Awareness
services.description: Provision of essential emergency medicines and medical equipment during Ethqaf Gwadar and Gwadar Ijtema (15–17 Sep 2023), alongside youth awareness programs on health, hygiene, drug prevention, and first aid.

disasters.title: Ganz Koh-e-Daran Disaster Rescue Operation
disasters.impact_summary: Multi-day Mountain Collapse Search & Rescue Operation
disasters.description: On Sunday evening (23 October 2022 at 4:00 PM), a group of picnickers from Bandari and Panwan were buried under rubble after a mountain collapsed at Hawachk Koh Daran (Ganz). Gwadar Ambulance Service deployed ambulances and rescue teams on-site across multi-day rescue operations.

disasters.title: Gwadar Flood Emergency Rescue (February 2024)
disasters.description: During the severe flood emergency in Gwadar on 26 February 2024, Gwadar Ambulance Service conducted rapid relief and evacuation operations, successfully rescuing 28 affected households in District Gwadar.

disasters.title: Gwadar Flood Emergency Rescue (March 2024)
disasters.description: Following recurring heavy rains and flooding on 11 March 2024, Gwadar Ambulance Service teams mobilized to rescue and assist 16 additional households in District Gwadar.

disasters.title: Youth Awareness Program at GBHS Jiwani
disasters.description: A comprehensive Awareness Program was conducted at Government Boys High School (GBHS), Jiwani focusing on education importance, health and hygiene, drug prevention, youth responsibilities, and community development through interactive lectures, discussions, and Q&A sessions with local facilitators.

disasters.title: Formal Coordination Meeting with Municipal Committee
disasters.description: The Chairman Municipal Committee conducted a formal coordination meeting with the Chairman of GASG (Gwadar Ambulance Service Gwadar) to discuss community welfare initiatives, establishing strong institutional linkage and formal agreement.

teamMembers.description: Head of Gwadar Ambulance Service Gwadar & Bin Ahsaan Welfare Trust, overseeing strategic governance, institutional linkages, and community welfare initiatives.
Provides strategic guidance, community consultation, and institutional oversight to the Chairman and leadership board.
Leads organizational execution, welfare operations, and coordination across Gwadar and adjoining areas.
Manages official records, registration compliance (Bcra-114272), organizational correspondence, and administrative governance.
Oversees financial stewardship, grant management, fuel and maintenance allocations, and welfare trust accounts.
Directs 24/7 ambulance dispatch, disaster rescue mobilization, mortuary operations, and field response across Gwadar and Kech.
Coordinates public awareness campaigns, community engagement, patient data reporting, and media documentation.
Supervises station personnel, shift schedules, and operational readiness at the ambulance station.
Oversees emergency medical supplies, Ethqaf and Ijtema medicine camps, first-aid training, and patient care standards.
Performs dignified ritual washing (Ghusl) and shrouding of the deceased (26 cases completed) and assists with mortuary care.
Operates GASG ambulances round the clock for emergency medical cases, obstetric deliveries, road traffic accidents, and deceased transport.
Supports ambulance station maintenance, equipment handling, stretcher assistance, and daily welfare operations.

projectsDemands.title: Installation of a 15 kW Generator and 15 kW Solarization System for the Mortuary
projectsDemands.subtitle: Uninterrupted Power & Lithium Battery Backup
projectsDemands.description: To ensure an uninterrupted power supply and maintain required health and preservation standards, we request the installation of a 15 kW generator along with a 15 kW solarization system equipped with lithium battery backup at the mortuary. This will provide a reliable and sustainable energy source for the proper functioning of mortuary facilities.

projectsDemands.title: Provision of Fuel & Maintenance
projectsDemands.subtitle: Continuous Ambulance & Mortuary Operations
projectsDemands.description: Arrange a regular supply of fuel and maintenance support for ambulance vehicles and mortuary operations to enable timely emergency response and continuous public service delivery.

projectsDemands.title: Establishment of an Office at the Ambulance Station
projectsDemands.subtitle: Administration, Coordination & Record Management
projectsDemands.description: For improved administration, effective coordination, communication, and proper record management, a dedicated office should be established at the ambulance station.

projectsDemands.title: Approval of Annual Grant
projectsDemands.subtitle: Sustainable Institutional Support
projectsDemands.description: Approve a sufficient and sustainable annual grant to ensure the uninterrupted and efficient functioning of the Gwadar Ambulance Service and the Mortuary.

projectsDemands.title: Empowering Communities with Life-Saving Skills and Emergency Medical Support
projectsDemands.subtitle: 24/7 Emergency Response + Weekly & Monthly First Aid Training
projectsDemands.description: The purpose of this initiative is to save lives, strengthen emergency response, and build a culture of preparedness across Gwadar and its underserved remote communities. Beyond providing rapid and 24/7 ambulance services, the project places strong emphasis on community empowerment through structured awareness and training programs. Through regular weekly and monthly sessions on first aid, emergency response, and medical awareness, individuals will be equipped with the knowledge and confidence to act as first responders in critical situations. This dual approach—immediate emergency response combined with proactive community education—significantly reduces preventable deaths and creates a lifesaving community network.

projectsDemands.title: Expansion of Ambulance Service to Jewni (Jiwani)
projectsDemands.subtitle: Extending 4+ Years of Free Gwadar Ambulance Coverage to Sub-Tehsil Jewni
projectsDemands.description: Having provided free ambulance services smoothly in Gwadar for 4 years and 5 months, Gwadar Ambulance Service proposes to extend ambulance coverage to the nearby underserved sub-Tehsil of Jewni. While Gwadar is served with reliable ambulance coverage, Jewni lacks such facilities. Our goal is to ensure every resident of the Gwadar district, including Jewni, has access to timely emergency ambulance service.
